verdict.rationale: OpenHands documents autonomous coding work. It accepts natural-language tasks, runs goal-directed loops with stop/resume, can auto-approve actions, and has workflows that update code and open pull requests for CI failures and security fixes. None of the evidence shows end-to-end feature implementation or writing tests specifically, so only the core autonomous-coding part of the story is supported. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of implementing new features end-to-end, any evidence of the agent writing or running tests, independent or hands-on corroboration.
